groups.activity: crack relics, sell Prime parts at a Relay Ducat Kiosk
conditions: Ducats cannot be traded and come only from selling items you own; do not sell every Prime part for platinum first.
bonuses: Credits: the Techrot Safe in Hollvania with Chroma's Effigy, a credit booster and a Credit Blessing can reach several hundred thousand in one safe.

disclosures.title: credits
disclosures.body: The Index on Neptune is the other common route: High Risk pays 250,000 per round won for a 50,000 entry. Sorties and Archon Hunts give about 100,000 between them.

disclosures.title: relic speed
disclosures.body: Radiant relics in fast fissures. Void Cascade is the usual answer; otherwise Capture or Rescue at low-level nodes with a fast frame.

groups.activity: buy it on a visit that stocks it
groups.meta: every two weeks for up to 48 hours
conditions: It is not permanent stock and the rotation order is not fixed. Missing a visit means waiting for it to come back.
The Vulkar is a separate item with its own Mastery.

disclosures.title: TennoCon
disclosures.body: Baro's TennoCon relay sells his entire catalog to anyone with a ticket, a guaranteed window if you are in.
